notes.title: Hello everyone!
notes.content:
Today, we've tried to address the most common issues that have arisen since the release of our game. Here's the list of changes:	
[list]	
[*] We've updated the hint interface to make it clearer how it works and what the cooldown is. Just to clarify: the hint cooldown is equal to the number of unopened cats, but it will never be less than 20 seconds.[*] We fixed the leaderboards! Now they work correctly for both the base image and DLC paintings.[*] As per your requests, we hid the interactive objects behind which the cats were hiding. Now you won't need to click on every object in the painting.[*] We've added system requirements so that new players can check if their device supports Doodle Cats.	
[/list]	
Happy upcoming New Year and Christmas! Thank you so much for playing our game! 🎄✨
